tasks.card.testGap.file: tests for a logic unit with no test file
tasks.card.testGap.why: No test file carries this unit’s name, so "{check}" does not run it.
tasks.card.testGap.step: Write tests through the unit’s public interface covering boundaries, empty values and error paths.
tasks.card.mutant.subject: an assertion that detects the surviving mutant: {mutant}
tasks.card.mutant.why: A mutant no test killed: the assertions do not tell this behaviour from its distortion.
tasks.card.mutant.step1: Read the mutant and its place, and determine which behaviour must differ after it.
tasks.card.mutant.step2: Add an assertion or a case that fails with the mutant and passes with the original code.
tasks.card.mutant.must: at least one test fails when this mutant is applied
tasks.card.uiState.why: A UI state with no written expectation: AYAR does not know what is correct there.
tasks.card.uiState.step1: Open the state in the UI and describe what must appear.
tasks.card.uiState.step2: Write the expectation in the states file, then re-check.
tasks.card.maintenance.why: A maintenance indicator over the declared threshold: a refactoring suggestion, no automatic change.
tasks.card.maintenance.step1: Review the function and split it into smaller units with one responsibility each.
tasks.card.maintenance.step2: Pin the behaviour with characterization tests before changing it, then re-check.
tasks.card.fix.subject: {id} ({title}) gone in a re-check
tasks.card.fix.why: This finding was copied to the model; it is not fixed until it disappears in a re-check without an integrity finding.
tasks.card.fix.step1: Apply the fix the model proposed, after reviewing it.
tasks.card.fix.step2: Re-check in AYAR; the card closes as verified when the finding is gone.
tasks.card.fix.must: {id} does not appear in the re-check, and the integrity guard finds no suppression on its check
tasks.card.claim.why: A model claim ({id}) you chose to follow; it is not proven until a local check or a test proves it.
tasks.card.claim.step1: Verify the claim at the named place and write a reproducing test if it is a defect.
tasks.card.claim.step2: Re-check in AYAR, or close the card with a recorded decision if it turns out not to be an issue.
tasks.verify.integrityFinding: the integrity guard found suppression or skipping on the card’s check
tasks.verify.checkDidNotRun: the related check did not run in this run
tasks.verify.findingPersists: the related finding is still present
tasks.verify.testsNotIncreased: the count of executed tests did not rise
tasks.verify.noTestCounts: no test counts in the check result
tasks.verify.checkNotPassed: the related check did not pass
tasks.verify.targetNotMentioned: no new test names the target
tasks.verify.noNewTest: no test file added or changed since the card was made
